## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Adeje, Spain. It starts at 15,Avenida Austria.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Dive into a world of watery adventure in Tenerife's Aqualand Costa Adeje. The park's giant waterslides, like the new and fun *Tsunami and Cyclones*, or *Tornado* and *Kamikaze*, *Twister Racer* and *Multisurf* are guaranteed to have you screaming for more, while the *Lava River* and wave pool are perfect for relaxing.
>
> Kids will have a blast splashing around in *Adventure Island* and *Pirate Port*, while grownups can get some me-time in the open-air spa, complete with jacuzzis and powerful hydro-massage showers.
>
> And then there are the majestic dolphins! You'll be able to catch your finned friends doing their fabulous thing with live shows at 3:30 pm every day in the dedicated arena.
>
> The whole family can make a splash in this watery wonderland!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €42.09. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 148 ratings and 65 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
